center.text:
Your beginning
▸
Your beginning

A livelihood in Reedbank

Optional original local life: repair Sella’s bread carriers at Mara’s stall. Begin selects one of two adult human starts, with one or two usable hands; both can use the holding jig. Your native name, gender, belongings and earlier progress remain in this save. No combat or Frontier campaign is required. This finite district has local walks and continuing repair work; it currently has no route back to Village. Closing the browser pauses its played clock.
